This strategic focus addresses a long-term threat to current cryptographic standards from advancements in quantum computing. By integrating quantum-resistant algorithms, CIRCLE aims to build an infrastructure that can secure digital assets and transactions against future computational capabilities. The project's commitment to this advanced security paradigm suggests an effort to establish a robust and forward-looking base layer for decentralized applications.
